newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates up in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates up in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates maintained their high levels because of a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.
They said rates were likely to remain high on Thursday despite an inflow of 2.3 billion rupees on the maturity of papers sold in an open market operation. Pakistan

Overnight funds were traded at 16.95 percent but overall trading was dull and borrowers approached the central bank to cover their positions, one dealer said. He said at the end of the day about 6.5 billion rupees were discounted with the central bank at 17 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
